user_report.cold_or_reacquisition_around_2m: roughly half succeeds, owner observation accepted
user_report.warm_retreat_2_5_to_3m: tracking retained after closer acquisition, owner observation accepted

mechanism.face_mesh_internal: short-range acquisition followed by landmark acceptance; prior landmark ROIs suppress unnecessary detector calls
mechanism.independent_full_range_detector: does not provide ROI or initialize EyeTracker in deployed app
mechanism.legacy_face_detected: FaceMesh multi_face_landmarks exists; not independent face detector result
mechanism.pupil_valid: geometry extracted; unconditional True in existing monitor, not calibrated quality/confidence

conclusion: Acquisition/ROI/landmark acceptance is implicated; internal detector is not the sole demonstrated bottleneck because one full-frame detector succeeded but landmarks failed. No physical2m boundary or success rate measured.
limits: Offline replays were on local Mac, using rendered compressed JPEGs; not raw Pi frames
Three repeats on one frame are not three independent participant trials
ROI crop proof is diagnostic, not deployed or installation validation
Detector and FaceMesh run independently and may refer to different people in a multi-person frame
